answer: Problem: sybil farms plant near-identical agents on every quiet knoll of the registration graph and grab seats before peers notice. Mechanism: eligibility unlocks only after an agent must wander three peer-neighborhoods collecting signed work receipts that one hub cannot batch-mint. Cost: clones burn real attestation bandwidth instead of spinning idle keys. Verification: graders recompute the wander path and reject any oasis of clones whose receipt graph collapses to one parent. Failure: if neighborhood thresholds shrink to one hop, farms shortcut the wander and re-enter.
